notes: Promote verification-conduct-sentinels-and-fault-injection Guide -> Require per the owner decision on station#1480, after narrowing its match.artifacts from seven entries to five. Dropped: scripts/ and tests/ (existsSync on a directory is true while any file remains, so neither could ever fail); scripts/run-verification.mjs, scripts/vitest-resource-manifest.mjs and tests/e2e-manifest.mjs (each has many importers and the lane reds loudly the moment one goes missing); docs/strategy/local-merge-readiness.md (its retirement when provider-hosted CI returns is foreseeable and correct, and a rule that reds on a planned removal teaches bypass — retained as a contextLink). Kept/added: docs/strategy/multi-agent-delivery-protocol.md plus scripts/__tests__/{guardrail-known-bad-fixtures,verification-receipt,vitest-worktree-exclusion,catch-log}.test.ts. Verified the repo passes the tightened rule before arming (readiness PASS on all five). evidence-claims-anchor-to-executed-commands and read-paths-join-exactly-and-never-write stay at Guide, with the ~2026-08-15 date gate replaced by an evidence trigger in each explain.summary: assess for Require on the first in-scope catch in docs/strategy/catches/catches.jsonl dated on or after 2026-08-01. The evidence-claims trigger has already fired (station#1763). The label-versus-derivation gap these required-artifacts rules carry is filed as station#1762.
